description: This file defines the MarkBased class, a dispatcher implementation for the FastRoute routing library. It extends the RegexBasedAbstract class and implements routing logic for variable routes using regular expressions.

classes.name: MarkBased
classes.description: A dispatcher class that processes route dispatching based on predefined regex patterns for variable routes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dispatcher with route data.

methods.name: dispatchVariableRoute
methods.description: Matches the given URI against route regexes and returns the route handler and variables if matched.
